reviews.title: Fortified libc calls compiled in (_FORTIFY_SOURCE)
reviews.summary: Binary was built with libc hardening checks enabled
reviews.description:
The binary imports glibc/musl fortified function variants (__fprintf_chk,
__memcpy_chk, __read_chk, ... or musl's __fortify_fail), which the
compiler emits only when built with -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 or 3 and
optimization enabled.
